optimod.config.title: Optimod Settings
optimod.option.blocked.tooltip: This module is disabled because %s provides the same feature. To force it on, turn off "Auto-disable overlaps" and restart the game.
optimod.option.entity_culling.enabled.to: Skip rendering entities and block entities fully hidden behind walls. Visibility is checked on a separate thread.
optimod.option.entity_culling.cull_entit: Mobs, items, frames, etc. Players and entities with visible names are never hidden.
optimod.option.entity_culling.max_check_: Objects farther than this are not checked and treated as visible.
optimod.option.entity_culling.update_int: Delay between culling thread passes. Lower reacts faster when turning corners but uses more CPU.
optimod.option.render_distance.enabled.t: Separate render distance for entities, block entities and particles, independent from chunk render distance.
optimod.option.render_distance.apply_to_: Apply the entity distance limit to other players too.
optimod.option.render_distance.entity.to: Entities beyond this distance are not rendered.
optimod.option.render_distance.block_ent: Block entities beyond this distance are not rendered (vanilla is usually 64). Beacons and other long-range ones are not affected.
Particles beyond this distance are not spawned.
optimod.option.particles.enabled.tooltip: Limit the number of particles alive at once.
optimod.option.particles.skip_out_of_vie: Do not spawn particles outside the camera view. Saves more, but long-lived particles (smoke) may disappear when you turn around.
optimod.option.particles.max.tooltip: No new particles are spawned above this number.
optimod.option.particles.out_of_view_dis: Closer than this, out-of-view particles are still spawned.
optimod.option.background.enabled.toolti: Lower FPS when the game window is unfocused or minimized.
Lower the volume while the game window is in the background.
FPS limit when the window is open but another app is active.
FPS limit when the window is minimized or fully covered.
optimod.option.background.volume.tooltip: Volume in background, percent of normal (0 = silence).
optimod.option.memory.enabled.tooltip: Save memory and clean up after loading.
Reuse identical entity model cubes. Requires a game restart.
optimod.option.memory.gc_after_loading.t: Free memory once after the game finishes loading.
Free memory after leaving a world (short pause).
optimod.option.animations.enabled.toolti: Update animated textures only when they are visible.
optimod.option.debug_overlay.only_with_f: Show the overlay only together with the debug screen (F3).
optimod.option.compatibility.auto_disabl: Turn off modules duplicated by installed Sodium, Iris, Dynamic FPS, EntityCulling. Requires a game restart.
